name: Ruffle Flash
description: PS5 Port of Ruffle Flash Emulator.
author: AZiZ
release_notes:
Ruffle Flash PS5 v1.2.0
Update: USB mouse and keyboard, a quick menu in games, themes, badges and more.

New
- USB mouse and keyboard: plug them into the PS5 and play, in games and in the menus
- Quick menu in games (touchpad or Esc): resume, restart, volume, retake cover, back to the library
- Themes: Ember, Midnight, Retro CRT and Newgrounds Dark, plus 7 accent colours
- Menu sounds: can be turned off
- Badges (achievements): 34 goals to unlock while you play, each with its own medal (can be turned off)
- Play time for every game
- Search your games: L2 on the controller, or just type on a keyboard
- Screensaver with your covers drifting by
- Mouse speed setting and a smoother cursor

Install
- Extract PPSA68091.zip and copy the PPSA68091 folder to /data/homebrew/.
- Load helper.elf together with kstuff.
- Put all your games (.swf) in /data/ruffle/games/.
- Start Ruffle Flash from the home screen.

Enjoy!
